def solve_n_queens(n, fixed):
    # fixed: dict row->col
    cols = [False]*n
    diag1 = [False]*(2*n-1) # row+col
    diag2 = [False]*(2*n-1) # row-col + n-1
    solution = [None]*n
    
    # apply fixed
    for r,c in fixed.items():
        if cols[c] or diag1[r+c] or diag2[r-c+n-1]:
            return None
        cols[c]=True
        diag1[r+c]=True
        diag2[r-c+n-1]=True
        solution[r]=c
    
    rows = [r for r in range(n) if solution[r] is None]
    
    def backtrack(idx):
        if idx==len(rows):
            return True
        r = rows[idx]
        for c in range(n):
            if not cols[c] and not diag1[r+c] and not diag2[r-c+n-1]:
                cols[c]=True
                diag1[r+c]=True
                diag2[r-c+n-1]=True
                solution[r]=c
                if backtrack(idx+1):
                    return True
                cols[c]=False
                diag1[r+c]=False
                diag2[r-c+n-1]=False
                solution[r]=None
        return False
    
    if backtrack(0):
        return solution
    else:
        return None
